name: stall-gaps
description: Decode gaps and engine steps while a cold 131K prompt prefills beside 7 of 16 decoding streams, four repeats, without and with 500-token probes sent 2-14 s into the prefill. Each repeat keeps its raw gaps and the engine steps the prefill spanned, split at 1,024 tokens. Built for experiments/2026-10-29-stall-gaps (#650).
